args: Set the Battery's Discharge cost to 0.01 $/kWh (fixed value) on the Home hub's Battery element and saved; HAEO confirmed 'Configuration updated successfully'. HAEO also created a Policy named 'Battery discharge cost' (Source: Battery element, Target: Any, Price 0.01 $/kWh), which is what applies the cost wherever the battery's energy goes. I did not edit or delete that policy. Possible double-count: both the battery field and the auto-created policy are at 0.01, so a discharged kWh may be charged 0.02 if both are applied; I could not verify from the UI which one HAEO uses.
